user.title: Connect to StudyOnTV
user.description: Enter the TV's LAN address and an integration token created on the device under Settings > Home automation.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the TV. Do not include http://, a path or a port.
data_description.port: HTTP port of the device panel (default 8099).
data_description.token: Token starting with sotv_. Read permission is required; enable Control permission to use control buttons.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected (401/403). Check that the integration is enabled and that the token has read permission.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Check the IP address, the port and that the StudyOnTV app is running.
error.rate_limited: The device is rate limiting requests (429). Wait a minute and try again.

init.title: StudyOnTV options
init.description: How often to poll the device. Each poll makes two requests, to /api/state and /api/device.
